name: 3D顔再構築分析
description: ビデオから3D顔面形状を再構築して、ディープフェイクの幾何学的不整合を検出します。
useCase: Detecting face 操作 through 3D geometric reconstruction and consistency 分析
mechanism: Fits a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to facial regions にわたる video frames and checks geometric consistency. Deepfakes often create faces that do not correspond to a valid 3D structure, producing impossible depth relationships, asymmetric geometry, or inconsistent 3D reconstructions 間の frames.
accuracy: 高 - 83-93%（顔交換ディープフェイク）
source: Zhu, X. et al. (2016) - Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution, CVPR
algorithm: 3DMM Fitting (BFM/FLAME) + Geometric Consistency + Temporal 3D Trajectory Analysis
parameters: モデル: Basel Face Model, Fitting: iterative optimization, Parameters: 199 shape + 29 expression, Frame window: 30
strengths:
• 3D幾何学的整合性を検証
• 深度の不整合を検出
• 2D操作では偽造が困難
• 照明分析と補完的
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い
• 正確な3D復元には高品質入力が必要
• 極端なポーズで精度低下
• 低解像度ビデオでは制限あり

references.title: Zhu, X. et al. (2016). Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution. CVPR.
Cozzolino, D. et al. (2021). ID-Reveal: Identity-aware DeepFake Video Detection. ICCV.
Deng, Y. et al. (2019). Accurate 3D Face Reconstruction with Weakly-Supervised Learning. CVPR Workshop.
